run_benchmark_texify: run the texify benchmark CLI to evaluate OCR accuracy on math equation images
run_benchmark_line_mode: run texify benchmark in line mode to process images with per-line bounding boxes
run_benchmark_max_rows: run texify benchmark on a subset of dataset rows for quick evaluation
score_text_predictions: score texify predictions against reference equations using normalized Levenshtein distance
inference_texify_images: run texify inference on a dataset of images to predict LaTeX equation text
